title: See how the rest of the world lives, organized by income | Anna Rosling Rönnlund
summary: Anna Rosling Rönnlund presents Dollar Street, a project photographing homes in dozens of countries, from stoves to beds to toilets, and sorting them by income. She shows how data visualization can change how we see the world.
why: HN recommends it as an insightful, perspective-giving look at how people live across income levels, useful as a counter to pessimism.

quote.text: It helps me put stuff in perspective
